description: Clock standards & lint compliance baseline for the 'no new debt' CI gate.
note: This baseline is used by .github/workflows/ci.yml. The CI fails ONLY if a PR regresses these numbers (i.e. makes compliance worse). Reducing them is the goal. Updated to reflect current fleet size (498 clocks) and current error counts after removing deprecated exports from enhancedFontLoader.ts and assetLoader.ts. Lint errors reduced from 577→383 via ESLint --fix and batch fixes. TypeScript errors in legacy clock pages remain at 2727 (fleet-wide migration required).
